paite: Huai thilte zoh in Athen a kipan Paul apawt a, Korinth ah ahohta hi.
heading: Korinth Khua Ah Paul

paite: Huan amin Akuila, Juda khat amu a, huai mi Pontus gam a piang ahi a, Klaudias in Judate tengteng Rome a kipan pawt thu apiak ziak a azi Priscilla toh Itali gam a kipan hong tung phet ahi uhi. Huai mite kiang ah Paul atungta hi.
Anasep uh kibang ahih ziak in amau akikoppih in nna asemkhawm ua; anasep uh puanin bawl ahi.
Sabbath teng in sinagog ah chitaktak in thu agen zel a, Judate leh Grikte thuzoh atum hi.
Masidonia gam a kipan Silas leh Timothi ahong tun un, Paul tuh kha phutluih in thu nasem in a-om a, tua Jesu zaw Khrist ahi chih Juda mite kiang ah atheihpih zel hi.
Himahleh akalh un agensia ua, Paul in apuan asing a, akiang uah, “Na sisan moh uh noumau lutung ah om hen; kei zaw ka hul ahi; tuban Zentelte kiang ah ka paita ding,” achi hi.
Huan huai a kipan apai a, amin Titas Justas mi khat inn ah alut a, huai mi'n Pathian abe zel hi, a-inn leng sinagog toh kizom ahi.
Huan Krispus pa sinagog heutu in a-inkuanpihte tengteng toh Toupa agingta a, Korinth a mi tampi'n leng za in agingta ua, baptisma atang uhi.
Zan in Toupa'n Paul kiang ah mengmu bang in, "Lau ke'nla, dai lou in thu gen zel in;
kei na kiang ah ka om akei hiam, sihna ding in kuamah in na tung ah khut akha kei ding uhi; hiai khua ah mi tampi ka nei ngal a," achi hi.
Huan huai ah alak uah Pathian thu hilh in kum khat leh kha guk a-omta hi.
Huan Akaia gam-ukpa Gallio ahih lai in Judate'n kituak in Paul kalh in buaina abawl ua, vaihawmna tutphah ma ah api uhi.
heading: Gallio Leh Paul

paite: “Huai mi'n dan lou bang in a Pathian be ding in mi athuzoh," achi uhi.
Paul in adawn dekleh Gallio in, Judate kiang ah, "Judate aw, hiai thil diklou thu hiam, thilhihkhelh thu hiam bek hileh, pel lou in ka hon awlmoh ding hi.
Himahleh thumalte leh minte, noumau dan thu lel zaw noumau kingaihtuah zaw un; ke'n zaw huchibang thu ngaihtuah ka ut kei," achi hi.
Huan vaihawmna tutphah a kipan in amau adelhkheta hi.
Huan Grik mi tengteng in sinagog heutu Sostheni aman ua, vaihawmna tutphah ma ah avua uhi. Gallio in athilhih uh khawk asa kei hi.

Huai zoh in Paul ni sawttak ataam nilouh a; huai zoh in unaute kampha in akha a, huai a kipan Siria gam lam ah long in apaita a, akiang ah Priscilla leh Akuila leng apai uhi. Paul in thuchiam aneih ziak in Kenkriai ah sam amet phot hi.
heading: Siria Antiok A Kik Nawnna

paite: Huan Ephesa atung ua, huai ah amau anusia a; himahleh amah kia sinagog ah alut a, Judate kiang ah chitaktak in thu asutpih hi.
Huan sawt deuh taam ding in akhou ua, himahleh ama'n lem asa kei a,
"Pathian in aphalleh na kiang uah ka hong nawn ding," chi in kampha in akhen a, Ephesa a kipan long in apaita hi.
Huan Kaisaria ah ahong kai a, Jerusalem ah ahohtou a, saptuamte chibai buk in, Antiok ah ahohsukta hi.
Huan huai a sawt kuam a-om nung in apai nawn a, nungzuite tengteng hihhat in Galatia gam leh Phrigia gam atawnsuak vek hi.
Huan Juda mi khat, amin Apollos, Aleksandria a piang, mipiltak, Ephesa ah ahohsuk a; ama'n Laisiangthou anak theih mahmah hi.
heading: Ephesa Ah Apollos

paite: Hiai mi'n Toupa Lampi thu zilsa ahi a, lungsim a phatuamngaitak ahih ziak in Toupa thu ahilh zel hi, Johan baptisma thu kia athei hi.
Sinagog ah hangsantak in thu agen hi. Huchi in Priscilla leh Akuila in athugen azak un, a-inn uah leh akiang ah Pathian Lampi thu kichian sem in ahilhchianta uhi.
Ama'n Akhaia gam a paikai atuptak in unaute'n ahanthawn ua, amah ana kipahpihna ding un nungzuite kiang ah lai agelhsak uhi. Huan atun in, Pathian hehpihna ziak a gingtate nakpitak in apanpih hi.
Vantang theih in Judate nakpitak in aseldong a, Laisiangthou zang in tua Jesu zaw Khrist ahi ngei chih atheisak hi.
